guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: And we reopened it.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: But it's been sealed again now! The danger is gone.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Incorrect. Without the power of the Eye, we have no way to seal the rift permanently. It will soon reopen once more. You should leave before that happens.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: No. This was our mistake. I'm staying to help fix it.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Me too!

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Cordelia
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Well if you two are staying, I guess I will as well.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Your support will be invaluable.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Tamara
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: [player name], could you go back to the Wizards' Tower and let Sedridor know what happened here?

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.player: Alright, if you're absolutely sure about this.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: Apprentice Felix
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: What about Persten? We have to help her.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: No part of the Abyss is more dangerous than the Scar. Your friend will have already been consumed.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.speaker: The Great Guardian
guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: Now, the power of the Abyss grows. The rift will soon reopen once more. Those of you staying should prepare yourselves.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.player: Then I guess I'd better go and see Sedridor. Good luck.

guardians-of-the-rift-closing-the-rift.text: The player returns to the Wizards' Tower.
Sedridor cutscene continues below.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: What do you mean? Was there no teleportation matrix?

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: Kind of, but not really. The portal took us to the Temple of the Eye, an ancient Saradominist temple built to house a powerful artefact.
Long ago, a rift to the Abyss was created in the temple, but it was sealed. At least it was, until Persten accidently opened it again...
She was sucked into the Abyss, and all these abyssal creatures came out!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Abyssal creatures? We have to get in there and stop this!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: It's okay again, for now. Some rune guardians called the Guardians of the Rift were built to protect the temple from the Abyss. They helped us close the rift again, but they say it will soon reopen.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: This is a disaster! I knew that teleportation matrix was too good to be true. I should have stopped this, but I was blinded by my own desires for that matrix!

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: They're safe. They chose to stay and help the Guardians of the Rift keep the rift closed.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Then I will ensure they have all the help they need. I will also begin researching this rift at once. Maybe we can still find a way to close it permanently.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: In the meantime, I suggest you do what you can to help them as well. After all, this is partially your doing.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: I know. I'll help wherever I'm needed.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Thank you, [player name]. I appreciate that you did not mean for things to go this way. You should have this. It belonged to Persten. I don't want to think about where she got it.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.player: Do you think she's still alive?

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Sadly, that seems unlikely. Still, if anyone can survive the Abyss, it's her.

guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
guardians-of-the-rift-sedridor-cutscene.text: Now, we'd better get to work.

post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
post-quest-dialogue-archmage-sedridor.text: Hello again, [player name]. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
How are things at the Temple of the Eye?

steps.player: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Between the Guardians of the Rift and ourselves, we are managing to keep the Abyss at bay.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: However, despite all our research, we are no closer to working out how to close the rift permanently.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Gaining a better understanding of the artefact that was once there is key, but we have found little mention of this 'Eye'.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research on it. After all, they knew enough about it to use its symbol as the symbol for our order.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Anyway, if you wish to help defend the temple, just head through the portal.

options.text: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?

steps.player: Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Of course. The first Wizards' Tower was built at the same time the Order of Wizards was founded. It was at the dawn of the Fifth Age, when the secrets of runecrafting were rediscovered.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: The tower was soon rebuilt of course, but even now we are still trying to regain knowledge that was lost.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: That's why I spend my time down here, in fact. This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Of course, one secret I am no longer looking for is the teleportation incantation to the Rune Essence Mine. We have you to thank for that.
If the player did not speak to the Mage of Zamorak about the abyssal incantation post-quest:
If the player spoke to the Mage of Zamorak about the abyssal incantation post-quest:

steps.player: I've heard a different take on how the tower burnt down. Something about a ritual gone wrong?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Nothing more than Zamorakian hearsay! They burnt the tower down and are now too cowardly to even admit it!

steps.player: Fair enough.

options.text: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.

post-quest-dialogue-mage-of-zamorak.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
post-quest-dialogue-mage-of-zamorak.text: Ah, you again. What do you want?

options.text: About that incantation your initiate gave me...

steps.player: About that incantation your initiate gave me...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Ah yes, the one to trace that amulet. Don't think I didn't notice that you modified the transmission spell I put on it. Next time you need help, we might not be so willing.

steps.player: Well maybe you should have asked first! Besides, you wouldn't have got anything useful out of it. In tracing that amulet, we accidently managed to open an uncontrollable rift to the Abyss.

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: And does this 'we' include the Order of Wizards?

steps.player: Maybe...

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: I knew it! It's just like them to play with magic they don't understand. First they burnt down the Wizards' Tower, now they're opening uncontrollable abyssal rifts!

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Perhaps the fools should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!

steps.player: Oh, that reminds me. That incantation didn't appear to be written on parchment. What was it?

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: Hmm... probably the flesh of an abyssal creature. Why do you ask?

steps.player: Oh, I just thought it might be human flesh. I'm relieved it wasn't!

steps.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
steps.text: You've been spending too much time with your friends in the Order of Wizards! I know that we Zamorakians have a bad reputation, but do you really think we'd be so barbaric?

options.text: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
Can you tell me more about your group?

0qD8qA.speaker: Wizard Persten
0qD8qA.text: That's a shame. Well, you just let me know if you reconsider.

0_QOga.player: I should probably get the amulet first.

AUUVFM.speaker: Mage of Zamorak
AUUVFM.text: Well then return to me when you are, but try not to waste too much of my time.
